create_whisper_config: create a WhisperConfig instance with default architecture settings for the encoder-decoder transformer
create_whisper_config_custom: create a WhisperConfig instance with custom encoder_layers, d_model, and decoder_layers for a tiny model variant
create_whisper_model_from_config: create a WhisperModel instance initialized from a WhisperConfig with random weights for inference
build_suppress_tokens_list: build a list of non-speech token ids to suppress during whisper audio generation for multilingual models
configure_spec_augment_masking: configure spec augment masking parameters including mask_time_prob, mask_feature_prob, and mask lengths for data augmentation
